title: Geometry capability matrix v2 — layered architecture audit
what_this_is: The authority for WHICH ARCHITECTURE LAYER handles each target geometry group. It is a snapshot audit read from code at as_of_head.
what_this_is_not: Not the product capability authority: backend/app/simulation/product_capability.py decides what the product may show as supported.
Not the closed family scope: docs/evaluation/geometry/missing-family-roadmap-refresh/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.json records the 12 families and their measured statuses.

Not a replacement of the v1 snapshot docs/architecture/architecture_capability_matrix.json (2026-09-25), which stays unchanged; v2 refines it by layer and corrects two v1 readings (see corrections_to_v1).

routes.LLM_ROUTE: default (DEFAULT_MODE = LLM_ONLY): analyze -> Semantic Program IR -> deterministic gates
routes.COMPILER_ROUTE: RequestContract -> FactGraph -> compiler; present but not wired into the default route

layer_count_note: The W13 brief says '16 layers' and names 17; all 17 named layers are kept.

layers.name: measurement_provenance

layers.name: interaction
layers.authority: Scene3DExplorer (select, scrub, isolate, explode); interaction = select and scrub, never drag (#31)

layers.name: fail_closed
layers.authority: stable refusal codes for inputs outside the closure (kernel, grounding, static check, scope gate)

layers.name: browser_evidence
layers.authority: authoritative browser artifacts on the CURRENT candidate (w12 suite); older artifacts are historical

layers.name: educational_evaluation
layers.authority: pedagogical evaluation with learners (MIGRATION_CHECKLIST GATE-20); human visual review is not this

status_rules: SUPPORTED: the layer handles the group generally (not one fixture) with code + test evidence; L16/L17 need a measured artifact on the CURRENT candidate.
PARTIAL: a sub-case only, one route only, or declared limits.
MISSING: no representation at this layer (or blocked upstream).
NOT_APPLICABLE: the layer has no role for this group.
OUT_OF_SCOPE_PENDING_DECISION: a user/thesis scope decision is needed before any work.
A renderer drawing a fixture never makes a group SUPPORTED: L11 SUPPORTED means the render path is generic, and L16 states separately whether it was ever measured.
Historical browser artifacts on an older candidate count as PARTIAL (evidence = HISTORICAL), never SUPPORTED.

taxonomy.POLYHEDRAL_SOLID: Closed polyhedral surface; planar polygonal faces; exact in Q^3; owns canonical edges and occluding SOLID_FACE surfaces.
taxonomy.CURVED_SOLID: Solid bounded by quadric surfaces given by parameters (KHOI_CONG: anchor, axis, radius); never a Polyhedron; tessellation exists only in the renderer.
taxonomy.AUXILIARY_GEOMETRY: Points, lines, segments, planes, vectors, feet and markers built to explain or measure (heights, perpendiculars, distance witnesses, angle markers, tangency witnesses); not part of a solid's boundary and never occluding.
taxonomy.DERIVED_SECTION: Object produced by intersecting a cutting object with a solid: polygonal sections (polyhedra), circles and ellipses (curved); always derived, never given; a circle is never a polygon.
taxonomy.COMPOSITE_SCENE: Scene with two or more solids or a solid-solid relation (inscribed, circumscribed, coexisting); boolean union/difference stays OUT_OF_SCOPE.

baseline_families_w12.root_cause: compiler.py::_bien_dich_prism emits no top polygon and no lateral-edge group

corrections_to_v1: v1 §3.C.2 calls the kernel Polyhedron 'convex'; since 2026-09-07 the volume is a signed boundary sum that is correct for closed non-convex shells (G06).

v1 §3.E marks Scene3D 'YES' for regular_tetrahedron / regular_pyramid / oblique_prism because the renderer can draw such a solid; v2 keeps renderer genericity (L11) apart from evidence (L16 MISSING) and from exact placement (L06 PARTIAL).
v1 §5 proposes construct_regular_pyramid; v2 prefers generic constructions (centre of a polygon, point along a normal) plus a placement-feasibility check, so no family primitive is needed.

capability_by_taxonomy.POLYHEDRAL_CAPABILITY: PARTIAL — general and concave polyhedra are exact and rendered on the LLM route; the compiler covers six right/box families with per-family formation; regular solids lack regularity semantics and often have no exact Q^3 placement; oblique prisms work on the LLM route only.
capability_by_taxonomy.CURVED_SOLID_CAPABILITY: PARTIAL — ball/cylinder/cone exact in the system (product foundation_only); formation is atomic; frustum missing (scope pending); curves are outside the occlusion classifier.
capability_by_taxonomy.AUXILIARY_GEOMETRY_CAPABILITY: PARTIAL — distances and angles exact by composition; dihedral by composition only, no marker; tangency missing.
capability_by_taxonomy.SECTION_CAPABILITY: PARTIAL — polygonal sections supported in the product; circle/ellipse sections exact in the system (foundation_only); parabola/hyperbola fail closed; curves not in occlusion evidence.
capability_by_taxonomy.COMPOSITE_SCENE_CAPABILITY: MISSING — SINGLE_SOLID_ONLY contract and compiler, one-solid occlusion; inscribed/circumscribed only by unmeasured composition; boolean composites out of scope.
